Banner.Title: Engineering the digital world from end to end
Banner.Description: With over 13 years of experience in web design and development, I have honed my skills in structure, functionality, configuration, testing, delivery, and maintenance. My expertise extends to web application design, architecture, implementation, and integration. I am known for being a responsible, intelligent professional who is process-oriented, a fast learner, and a self-starter. I excel in problem-solving and stay updated with the latest technologies and standards. Possessing excellent communication skills, I work effectively both independently and as a productive team member, capable of taking on leadership and mentoring roles. My motivation and commitment to excellence make me a valuable asset in any professional setting.
AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: With 12+ years of professional experience in software development, I have successfully contributed in multiple roles such as System Analyst, Frontend Architect, Backend Developer, and Technical Leader. My expertise lies in building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance applications with a strong focus on frontend architecture, especially in Angular and modern web technologies.

I have a proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise-level applications, ensuring performance optimization, standardizing coding practices, and driving best-in-class UI/UX experiences. I consistently contribute to improving system efficiency, streamlining development processes, and introducing patterns that enhance scalability and maintainability.

Beyond development, I enjoy mentoring teams, fostering a culture of clean code, and driving technical discussions that shape project direction. My leadership approach combines empathy, collaboration, and clear goal-setting to empower teams and deliver high-quality outcomes. I’ve also actively led code reviews, architectural discussions, and CI/CD adoption to ensure long-term project success.

I have hands-on experience with unit testing, integration testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices, ensuring robust delivery pipelines and high code coverage. On the backend, I’ve successfully contributed using ExpressJS, NestJS, MongoDB, and MySQL, making me comfortable in full-stack environments when needed.

My passion extends beyond professional projects—I frequently experiment with personal utilities and side projects to sharpen my skills, explore new frameworks, and stay aligned with industry best practices. I constantly keep myself updated with Angular’s evolving versions and ecosystem, leveraging RxJS, NgRx, and microfrontend strategies to build dynamic and resilient applications.

Some of the key areas of my expertise include (but are not limited to): Frontend Architecture, Angular (1.x – 17+), TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, State Management, UI Frameworks, Design Systems, Performance Optimization, CI/CD, and Team Leadership.

OtherProjects.Projects.Description: This project focuses on creating a robust multitasking collaborative application designed to streamline communication and task management among different user roles, including Patients, Doctors, and Admins. The application enables seamless collaboration through real-time chat, file sharing, and task assignments, improving productivity and organization. Built with modern web technologies such as AngularJS, Angular Material, JavaScript, and Socket.IO, the app ensures an interactive and responsive user experience while supporting scalable back-end operations and version control using Git.
OtherProjects.Projects.SubDescription:
• Developed a multitasking collaborative application facilitating communication and coordination among Patients, Doctors, and Admins.
  • Implemented real-time chat and notifications using Socket.IO to enhance user interaction.
  • Enabled file sharing and document management for seamless collaboration across user roles.
  • Designed task assignment and tracking modules to improve workflow efficiency.
  • Created responsive and interactive UI using AngularJS, Angular Material, HTML, CSS3, and Sass.
  • Leveraged JavaScript and jQuery to handle dynamic functionalities and client-side logic.
  • Utilized Gulp for task automation and project build optimizations.
  • Managed version control and collaborative development using Git.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Doctor Stay - Patient & Clinical System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Doctor Stay - Patient & Clinical System is a comprehensive healthcare management application designed to streamline interactions among patients, doctors, and administrators. The system allows patients to book appointments with registered doctors, provides doctors with tools to manage patient profiles, generate digital prescriptions, and maintain patient history. The admin module enables efficient verification of users, subscription management, and application promotions. The application leverages modern web technologies for a responsive, robust, and scalable solution.
OtherProjects.Projects.SubDescription:
• Developed Doctor Stay - Patient & Clinical System, a comprehensive healthcare management application with distinct modules for Patients, Doctors, and Admins.
  • Enabled patients to book appointments, view medical history, and communicate digitally with doctors.
  • Provided doctors with features to manage patient profiles, maintain history, and create digital prescriptions.
  • Admin module supports user verification, subscription management, and application promotion.
  • Integrated SOAP-based Web APIs for seamless server-client communication.
  • Implemented dynamic front-end using AngularJS (1.x), JavaScript, and JQueryUI.
  • Structured data handling and storage using SQL Server 2012 and XML.
  • Developed server-side functionality using ASP.NET Framework 4.0 and C#.
  • Managed code versioning and collaboration via GIT.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: RecruitBazaar - Job Management System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: This project is a comprehensive job management system designed to streamline recruitment processes for companies, consultants, and candidates. The system includes a console application for sending bulk emails, allowing users to capture email addresses and send festival greetings from the master application settings. Additionally, it supports sending emails with Excel sheet attachments generated by the existing system. The platform is structured into three main modules: company, consultant, and candidate, each with role-based access to features such as job posting, candidate hiring, MCQ tests, CV review, and interview scheduling. The front-end presentation layer is developed using Angular and AngularJS (1.x), along with JQueryUI for UI interactions, while the back-end is powered by ASP.NET Framework 4.0, C#, and SQL Server 2012. Communication with external services is handled via SOAP-based Web APIs, and version control is managed using GIT. The system leverages XML for data exchange and integrates seamlessly with other applications.
OtherProjects.Projects.SubDescription:
• Developed RecruitBazaar – a comprehensive job management system with console and web-based features for companies, consultants, and candidates
  • Implemented bulk email functionality, capturing email addresses and sending festival greetings from master application settings
  • Enabled sending emails with Excel sheet attachments generated by the existing system
  • Structured the system into three role-based modules: company, consultant, and candidate
  • Designed and implemented features including job posting, candidate hiring, MCQ tests, CV review, and interview scheduling
  • Developed the front-end using Angular, AngularJS (1.x), and JQueryUI for interactive UI components
  • Implemented back-end services with ASP.NET Framework 4.0, C#, and SQL Server 2012
  • Integrated SOAP-based Web APIs for communication with external systems
  • Used XML for structured data exchange between modules
  • Managed version control and collaborative development using GIT

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Custom CMS - Portfolio Management System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Developed a comprehensive Custom CMS consisting of two separate websites — one for the company portal and another for the client portal. Designed basic themes and logos for both company and clients. Implemented a cPanel for seamless management of products, services, and other digital content. Ensured smooth front-end and back-end integration using modern web technologies.
OtherProjects.Projects.SubDescription:
• Developed and maintained two distinct websites: Company Portal and Client Portal, ensuring a responsive and user-friendly interface.
  • Designed and implemented basic themes and logos for both the company and its clients, maintaining consistent branding.
  • Implemented a cPanel for digital content management, enabling easy addition and modification of products, services, and other information.
  • Utilized ASP.NET (C#) for server-side development, ensuring secure and efficient back-end operations.
  • Configured and managed SQL Server 2010 for database management, including CRUD operations and data integrity checks.
  • Developed front-end functionalities using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap to create an interactive and responsive user experience.
  • Integrated Git for version control, ensuring efficient collaboration and project tracking.
  • Conducted testing and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables and seamless performance across portals.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Report Board - Report Management System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Report Board is a web-based report management system designed to interact with a server-hosted database to generate comprehensive and customizable reports. The application provides a user-friendly interface for querying data, visualizing reports in HTML format, and exporting them into multiple formats like Excel and PDF. The system leverages modern front-end technologies and robust back-end development practices to ensure high performance, responsiveness, and scalability.
OtherProjects.Projects.SubDescription:
• Query Builder Module:
    • Enables users to create custom queries on the database without direct SQL knowledge.
    • Supports filtering, sorting, and complex query constructions dynamically.
  • Report Generation Module:
    • Generates detailed reports in a clean and interactive HTML view.
    • Ensures data accuracy and consistency while rendering complex datasets.
  • Export Functionality:
    • Allows exporting reports into Excel and PDF formats for offline access.
    • Maintains formatting and data integrity across exported files.
  • Front-End Development:
    • Used HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, and Telerik UI to create a responsive and intuitive interface.
    • Implemented AJAX for seamless data retrieval and updates without full page reloads.
  • Back-End Development:
    • Developed in ASP.NET (C#) for robust server-side logic.
    • Connected to SQL Server 2010 for efficient data storage and retrieval.
    • Ensured secure and optimized database interactions for large datasets.
  • Overall Contribution:
    • Collaborated in requirement analysis and designed modular features.
    • Enhanced system performance, user experience, and reporting capabilities.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Email Plug
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: The Email Plug project is a console-based application developed using C#.NET with version control managed via SVN. The application is designed to automate the process of sending bulk emails efficiently. It extracts email addresses through a dedicated function and allows sending personalized messages, including festival greetings, directly from the master application settings. As an add-on or plugin to the existing system, it enhances email communication by enabling attachments of dynamically generated Excel sheets to the recipients’ emails. This tool significantly reduces manual effort and ensures timely delivery of emails to a large list of users.
OtherProjects.Projects.SubDescription:
• Developed a console application to automate bulk email sending with efficiency and reliability using C#.NET.
  • Implemented a function to capture email addresses dynamically from the existing system for targeted communication.
  • Enabled sending festival and event greetings directly from the master application settings.
  • Integrated functionality to attach Excel sheets generated by the existing system to emails.
  • Designed the application as an add-on plugin, ensuring seamless integration with existing software workflows.
  • Managed source code and version control using SVN.
  • Optimized error handling and logging to ensure reliable delivery and easy troubleshooting.
  • Streamlined internal and external communication processes by automating repetitive email tasks.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Leave Management System
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: The Leave Management System is a comprehensive platform designed to streamline the leave request and approval process within an organization. It allows employees to submit leave requests, which are automatically routed to relevant authorities such as the HR Manager, Project Manager, Department Head, and Team Leader. The system supports multi-level approvals: a leave request is sanctioned if the majority of approvers approve it, and rejected if the majority deny it. This ensures transparency, accountability, and efficient leave management.
OtherProjects.Projects.SubDescription:
• Employee self-service module to create, submit, and track leave requests.
  • Multi-level approval workflow involving HR Manager, Project Manager, Department Head, and Team Leader.
  • Majority-based leave sanctioning or rejection system for fair decision-making.
  • Dashboard for approvers to view pending requests, approve or reject, and provide remarks.
  • Real-time notifications to employees and approvers regarding leave status updates.
  • Search and filter functionality to track leave requests by date, employee, or department.
  • Integration with SQL Server 2008 for secure and structured data storage.
  • Responsive and user-friendly interface using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
  • Version control and collaboration enabled using GIT.
  • Improved organizational efficiency by automating the leave request and approval process.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Lab Management System - Soil & Material Test & Report Management
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: The Lab Management System is designed to streamline and automate the process of conducting material tests, recording observations, calculating results, and generating reports. The system captures raw test data from machines, applies client-specific testing equations, and stores results in a secure database. It allows multiple tests on the same material to ensure accuracy and provides detailed reports for builders and company records, improving efficiency, transparency, and data-driven decision-making in material testing processes.
OtherProjects.Projects.SubDescription:
• Developed a comprehensive system for managing soil and material tests, reducing manual errors and improving data accuracy.
  • Implemented automated calculation of observation values and test conclusions based on client-specific equations.
  • Designed and integrated a module to store test results securely in SQL Server, allowing for efficient retrieval and analysis.
  • Enabled multiple tests per material to ensure consistency, reliability, and optimal material quality assessment.
  • Developed dynamic report generation functionality for both client-facing and internal documentation.
  • Utilized ASP.NET and C# for backend logic, ensuring robust performance and maintainability.
  • Built responsive, user-friendly interfaces using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript for ease of use by lab personnel.
  • Implemented version control and collaboration using GIT to manage source code efficiently.
  • Worked closely with clients to understand testing requirements and translated them into functional software solutions.
  • Ensured the system could handle large volumes of test data while maintaining fast performance and accuracy.
